title: compactionFit operation
description: The COMPACTION BENCH (DEV.md 4c C195): the Heckel, Kawakita and Ryshkewitch-Duckworth models of a pharmaceutical powder, each fitted by least squares on the straight line its authors wrote, to a declared dataset of ONE material. The Heckel and Kawakita pressure windows are DECLARED by the case, never chosen by the op; a window with no point, or with fewer than 4, refuses. The equations, citations and validity statements are printed beside the numbers, and values the source itself reports are printed beside the fitted ones as a cross-check. No mixture rule is implemented: an excipient stands in for the blend.

material.title: Material
material.description: What the dataset is, as printed in the source (e.g. "Avicel PH-102").

dataset.title: Compaction dataset
dataset.description: Path to a self-describing dataset dict, relative to the case: columns P [MPa]; exactly one of D [-], porosity [-] or density [g/cm3]; optionally sigma_t [MPa] or F [N] with d [mm] and t [mm]; optionally V [mL] or C [-]. A model block may name its own dataset.

trueDensity.title: True density
trueDensity.description: The material's true (pycnometric) density, e.g. `1.59 g/cm3`; required only when the dataset gives the compact's `density`.

heckel.title: Heckel fit
heckel.description: ln(1/(1-D)) = K P + A on the DECLARED linear region; mean yield pressure Py = 1/K.

Pmin.description: lower end of the linear region, e.g. `50 MPa`

Pmax.description: upper end of the linear region

reason.description: why this window (the source's own choice, the curvature seen, ...)

dataset.description: a dataset for this model only

kawakita.title: Kawakita fit
kawakita.description: P/C = P/a + 1/(a b), C = (V0 - V)/V0, on the declared pressure window.

initialVolume.description: V0 [mL], when the dataset gives V

initialRelativeDensity.description: D0 (bulk / true density), when C is read from the relative density: C = 1 - D0/D

ryshkewitch.title: Ryshkewitch-Duckworth fit
ryshkewitch.description: sigma_t = sigma_0 exp(-k_b eps), fitted on ln(sigma_t); sigma_t tabulated or computed as 2F/(pi d t) (Fell & Newton 1970).

reported.title: Values the source reports
reported.description: The source's own fitted values (Py, A, a, invb, sigma0, kb), printed beside the fitted ones; never used to tune.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` -- the published tables, one block per model.
